newsitem.title: USA: USF&G Insurance to buy Charter House.
newsitem.headline: USF&G Insurance to buy Charter House.

text.p: USF&G Corp's USF&G Insurance said on Thursday it agreed to buy Charter House, a wholesale agency with $22 million in premiums, for undisclosed terms.

This deal, set to be completed January 1, 1997, would increase USF&G's ability to provide a comprehensive array of coverage, it said. Charter House has served the public entity market since 1982, USF&G Insurance said.
USF&G also said the acquisition supported its strategy of growing its commercial insurance business.
Tom Ramsbacher, vice president of USF&G's commercial insurance group, would also become president of the new managing general agency, to be called "Charter House Underwriters Inc," the company said.
